minions._about: Minion rules (D4b). upkeep: while a hero's MINION ITEMS have live minions the holder pays this per minion item (percent of the level stat, like item effects; hero passives like the Necromancer's skeletons cost nothing). revivalFloors: a dead greater minion comes back after this many floors are cleared. copyStatBonus: each extra copy of a greater-minion item adds this share of its health and attack (no second minion). itemWeakCap: the shared cap of weak minions from a hero's items. upkeepWeakScale: weak spawner items cost this much of the full upkeep (greater = full). Boosters (Bone Charm, Overseer's Whistle, Grave Dust, Necro Crown) cost nothing and reach every minion.

books._about: Skill book limits per skill (pages in skillBooks.json): stat pages may repeat, a modifier only once per skill; a new modifier on a full skill replaces one the player picks.

skillWindUp._about: Skills wind up before they go off (castMs per skill in skills.json, else defaultCastMs). The skill goes on cooldown when tapped; stunned, frozen or silenced during the wind-up = the skill is lost (still on cooldown). No basic attacks and no walking while winding up.

skillFx._about: How a skill looks when it goes off (C2), so it is clearly different from a normal hit: the caster flashes in the skill colour, a ring bursts (at the target for attack skills, at the caster for support), a name banner, bigger coloured damage numbers, and attack skills shake the screen with a tiny hit-stop.

movement._about: Real movement in fights (BattleState.move). Melee walk to their target at walkSpeedPxPerSec until it is inside the reach oval (reachX sideways, reachY up/down), then swing. Fighters closer than the separate oval push apart; a fighter standing still gives way only settledPushShare as much as a walking one, and within wallSoftPx of a side wall it is hardly pushed further towards it; two fighters both standing still drift apart at only settledPairPush of the speed. layout = where the lines stand (also used by tests/bot). BIG fighters (bosses): body size = sprite width / normalBodyPx (at least 1); the push-apart oval grows with the two sizes and a melee fighter can hit a big target from its edge (reach grows with the target's size), so nobody stands inside a boss.

bossIntro._about: A boss floor: when the squad is in place the boss ROARS (sound bossRoar) and the camera shakes (shakeMs, shakeIntensity), then nobody moves for waitMs before the fight starts (BattleScene.startFighting).

enemyTiers._about: Fodder (enemies.json tier) from fromFloor: health/attack x hpScale/attackScale, floor growth x growthShare (so they stay fodder deep down), XP x xpScale, drawn at drawScale (smaller).

elites._about: Elite enemies (BattleState.makeElite; which floors/how often: dungeons.json director.elites). An elite = health x healthMultiplier, attack x attackMultiplier, +defense/+resist, drawn drawScaleBonus pixel size bigger, XP x xpMultiplier, ONE element + ONE trait (random, equal odds). Element: its hits use damageType (it still walks/shoots like before), onHit statuses, resists/weak added (and removed from the other list), lifesteal %, jumpEvery = every Nth hit also jumps to a second hero (jump.damageMultiplier), onDeath = a cloud like the Puffshroom. Trait: lifesteal %, shieldPercent (of max health, regrows after regrowMs without being hit), thorns % (melee hits), split (dies into count non-elite copies with hpPercent of its max health each, drawn 1 smaller), regenPercentPerSec, statusDurationScale (control statuses), burst (on death: damageMultiplier x its attack as its element's damage on heroes/minions within radius + the element's onHit statuses).
